{{Quote|&hellip; The Quermian [Lord Bactra] was an outsider. He was a friend to our family for many years&mdash;but he couldn't change what he was. I felt the need for Bactra was past&ndash;and he gave us the opportunity to do something about it.|Vilia Calimondra's justification for the invasion of the Bactranate|<ref name="Knight Errant (novel)">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>}}
In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the joint forces of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Daiman]], [[Odion]], [[Lioko]], and [[Malakite]] spearheaded an '''invasion''' into the holdings of the [[Bactranate]], the territory of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]]. The invasion began with an [[Battle of Jutrand|attack]] on the Bactranate's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Jutrand]], which was conquered by Odion. Shortly thereafter, the Bactranate was wholly dissolved.

==History==
{{Quote|Bactra's territories have already fallen to those nearest: Daiman, Odion, Lioko, and Malakite. That is as it should be. But his greatest assets are his corporate holdings, which call no single world home.|Vilia distributing the Bactranate's territories and assets among her "children"|<ref name="Knight Errant (novel)" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Jutrand|conquest]] of [[Jutrand]], [[Odionate]], [[Daimanate]], [[the Menagerie]] and [[Lioko]]'s forces invaded the Bactranate which collapsed within a few days. During a subsequent [[bequest]] convened by Vilia, Daiman obtained control of [[Industrial Heuristics]], the most prized of Bactra's corporate assets. However, Odion protested and claimed that he had a right to the company since it had been headquartered on Jutrand, which had been bequeathed to him. As quid pro quo, Vilia allowed him to keep Jutrand and arrange for the transfer of two legions of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] warriors from her own forces to augment Odion's troops. Bactra's remaining corporate assets were redistributed among her other grandchildren particularly Lioko and Malakite whose forces had also participated in the invasion. During the bequest, Vilia's granddaughter and Sith Lord [[Arkadia Calimondra]] cited an intelligence source that Bactra had gone into hiding at a Quermian retirement colony.

The Sith Lord Odion also acquired [[Jubalene]] where he enslaved the population and put them to work in war forges. Meanwhile, he had all the children within his portion of the former Bactranate including those in Jutrand and Jubalene imprisoned and indoctrinated at planet-sized orphanages known as [[Odionate cloister|cloisters]]. To satisfy his sadistic nihilistic pleasures, Odion also made use of Bactra's now redundant bankers and attorneys by coercing them into participating in violent arena fights against wild beasts like [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] and [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]]. The elimination of the Bactranate also enabled Odion to restart [[Project Pandemonium]], a project to locate the ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] known as the [[Helm of Ieldis]]. It was capable of driving sentient beings into a mindless homicidal frenzy. As part of his campaign to launch a galactic apocalypse, Odion's forces also invaded [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]] to secure information on the Helm. While Sarrassia had nominally been under the influence of Bactra who [[Conquest of Sarrassia|ended]] the religious conflict between the [[Grumani Hierophant]]s and the [[Spumani Crusader]]s, he had left the planet alone. Odion in contrast destabilized Sarrassian society.

After acquiring the Helm on [[Skarpos]], Odion attempted to launch his apocalypse from his base at [[Vanahame]] by using the emotional energies of the imprisoned children. However, he was foiled by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and his former second-in-command, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Beld Yulan]]. Following his death, the Odionate collapsed and its territories were divided up among the Calimondra territory.
